reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, spreadsheet access, batching, and undo wrappers, but shares only fragments of month-wide category selection.

duplication.why: Category queries and income/protected-category eligibility checks remain repeated across the six month-wide actions.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculation logic stays in budget/actions.ts, with handler registration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions and new method registration.

maintainability.why: The shared protection lookup helps, but maintaining eligibility across repeated queries, local guards, and two hidden-group modes remains unnecessarily difficult.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth implements hidden-category eligibility locally instead of using the hiddenFilter abstraction introduced for the other month-wide actions.

disguised_duplication.where: Hidden-category eligibility appears as SQL in hiddenFilter and as an equivalent JavaScript guard in copyPreviousMonth, while category eligibility is split between queries and repeated loop guards.

abstraction_drift.where: hiddenFilter introduces includeHidden and strictGroup parameters with branches for inclusion and group-null handling; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it with its own hidden-category condition.
